canonical.content:

Paths: app-note/app/database.py, app-note/app/sync_logging.py
Summary: Fix notestack 502: handle OSError in sync_logging mkdir and UniqueViolation race in postgres init - Wrap sync_logging path.mkdir(path.touch) in try/except OSError to prevent PermissionError crash when LOCALAPPDATA dir is unwritable. - Retry get_connection() in _initialize_postgres_db() with backoff. - Wrap each DDL/ini
